chart.name: Variation in requests/host (%)
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.zk_packets_sent', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'), rollup='rate').mean().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('counter.zk_packets_sent', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'), rollup='rate').stddev().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/A*100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Data size 24h change %
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_approximate_data_size', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).sum().max(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('gauge.zk_approximate_data_size', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).sum().max(over='1h').timeshift('1d').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B - 1).scale(100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Total requests/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.zk_packets_sent', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('counter.zk_packets_received', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B')

chart.name: Top hosts by file descriptor % used
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_max_file_descriptor_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('gauge.zk_open_file_descriptor_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/A*100).top(count=5).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top hosts by avg request latency (ms)
File descriptors used and total
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_max_file_descriptor_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('gauge.zk_open_file_descriptor_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum().publish(label='B')

chart.name: Variation in connections/host (%)
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_num_alive_connections', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).mean().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('gauge.zk_num_alive_connections', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).stddev().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/A*100).mean(over='5m').publish(label='C')

chart.name: Request latency (ms)
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_avg_latency', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: Node count 24h change %
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.zk_znode_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).sum().max(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('gauge.zk_znode_count', filter=filter('plugin', 'zookeeper')).sum().max(over='1h').timeshift('1d').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B - 1).scale(100).publish(label='C')
